title: Matamshi Bora (Theme 6: Usafi wa mazingira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the target sound as one syllable (dha-ha-bu), says it in one beat, and checks it in the word.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels a, e, i, o, u and reads open syllables (ma, me, mi, mo, mu).
floor.question: Soma: ma - ma

representations: clapping one beat for each syllable
a sentence with the sounds: Tuliokota chupa thelathini tukasafisha mazingira.
steps: Say the word in one go and use it in a sentence.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child says each word on the card and claps its syllables.

misconceptions.ask: Kuna sauti gani baada ya herufi ya kwanza katika "thelathini"?
misconceptions.repair: Sikiliza tena: "thelathini". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.

misconceptions.ask: Kila silabi inaishia kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: dha-ha-bu.

misconceptions.ask: Sauti hiyo iko wapi katika neno hili?

checks.question: Ni neno lipi lina sauti lengwa: thelathini au mama?
